title: Chapter 2686 - 81: Wood Revitalization Formation (3)
content:
Chapter 2686: Chapter 81: Wood Revitalization Formation (3)

What is needed is a large amount of Divine Sense, wood-series Spiritual Ink, and a high level of Formation mastery.

Even because Mo Hua was the one Drawing the Formation, he could even use "earth" as the Formation media.

This is the mysterious aspect of Formations.

It is also the strength of a high-level Formation Master.

The Wood Revitalization Formation, Mo Hua had learned long ago.

His nature is that of a "formation fanatic," with a strong curiosity and a thirst for knowledge.

Whenever he saw a Formation, he wanted to acquire it. Every Formation he acquired, without exception, he wanted to learn.

This Wood Revitalization Formation was naturally no exception.

Though it is an obscure Medical Array, for Mo Hua, who practiced with "Ultimate Formations" daily, it wasn’t too difficult.

Mo Hua actually learned it a long time ago.

But he never healed people, so the Wood Formation had never been used, and Mo Hua didn’t know whether it would work or how effective it would be.

But in the current situation, there were no other choices.

Mo Hua selected a clean spot on the ground, sat cross-legged, and took out several bottles of pale green wood-series Spiritual Ink from his Storage Bag.

Mo Hua rarely used wood-series Spiritual Ink.

He most commonly used fire-series Spiritual Ink to draw Earth Fire Formations to blow people up, instantly silencing a group.

Blowing people up with Earth Fire Formations is actually quite addictive.

This pleasure is only understood by those who have experienced it.

Unfortunately, ever since committing a fateful evilness, he had to "keep himself clean," and Mo Hua hadn’t used Earth Fire Formations on people for a long time, nor experienced such pleasure.

Mo Hua felt a bit regretful.

Then he focused intently and began to draw the Wood Revitalization Formation.

This was his first time seriously painting this obscure "Medical Array" with the intent of "applying what he learned."

The pale green Spiritual Ink, controlled by Mo Hua’s Divine Sense, meandered in the air before flowing onto the ground, like a spiritual snake, coalescing into an ancient Wood Formation with a breath of wood and plants.

This was merely a Second Grade Nineteen Patterns Formation.

To an ordinary Foundation Establishment Formation Master, this kind of Formation would naturally be considered Second Grade "top tier."

But to Mo Hua, it was quite ordinary, and he finished it in no time.

Mo Hua scrutinized the Formation, suddenly frowning.

He had indeed drawn the Formation.

But in his heart, there was an inexplicable, peculiar, self-doubting feeling.

Even though the Formation was complete, not a single Pattern missing, he always felt as if he hadn’t actually drawn the Formation.

As if he had omitted something.

No...

It wasn’t that something was missing, but that what had been drawn didn’t seem to be the right Formation.

This unsettling sense of dislocation left Mo Hua very puzzled.

But this was only his intuition; in reality, a Wood Revitalization Formation was perfectly displayed before him.

Mo Hua thought for a moment and then laid down on the Formation.

Spiritual Power began to circulate, transforming into Yimu Qi through the Formation, infiltrating his meridians, nourishing his Blood Qi.

The gentle, fresh breath of vegetation even made Mo Hua feel refreshed.

"No problem at all..."

Mo Hua muttered, frowning.

He scrutinized the entire Formation again, meticulously comparing it, stroke by stroke, against the Formation Diagram on the Jade Slip, but couldn’t find anything amiss.

Mo Hua shook his head, deciding not to ponder it further for the time being.

Then he continued to use Divine Sense Control Ink to draw five more Wood Revitalization Formations on the ground, filling the entire stone chamber with Yimu Qi.

Mo Hua ground Spirit Stones into powder, integrated it into the Formation, and then took out a blanket to cover the Formation.

Then he ceremoniously sat cross-legged on the ground, and said a few prayers to the "Divine Lord."

Once the Formation was safely running and everything was confirmed to be in order, Mo Hua, with a serious expression, got up and left.

Dan Zhu and the others, who had been anxiously waiting for a long time, hurriedly asked as soon as they saw Mo Hua come out:

"Mr. Witch, the Divine Lord..."

Mo Hua spoke with a compassionate demeanor:

"The Divine Lord above, merciful to all beings, has already used Divine Skills to communicate and imparted the Holy Pattern for healing to me. However..."

Mo Hua’s expression was somewhat solemn, "I haven’t fully mastered it; these Holy Patterns are not even one ten-thousandth of the Divine Way power, so whether or not they can save everyone remains to be seen..."

Mo Hua stated this upfront.

The "Divine Lord" imparted the Dao to him, allowing him to save people.

But if the people weren’t saved, it was his own lack of skill, not the Divine Lord’s lack of power.

He would take the blame for his "Divine Lord."

The Shaman can be doubted, but the Divine Lord cannot.

Dan Zhu, unaware of Mo Hua’s thoughtful scheming, was simply moved and sincerely said:

"Regardless, it is a gift from the Divine Lord. Thank you, Mr. Witch."

Mo Hua nodded, then said, "Bring the injured into the house."

The first batch of six wounded individuals was carried into the stone chamber and placed on the Wood Revitalization Formation as per Mo Hua’s orders.

The Formation activated, and the Formation Patterns lit up sequentially.

The blue-green light enveloped the wounded completely.

As time passed, wisps of fresh plant breath turned into beams of blue light, permeating the meridians of the injured, replenishing their Blood Qi, healing their bodies, and even to some extent, combating the scarlet venom of the Blood Tooth Grass.

The injuries of these wounded visibly improved.

The effect of the Wood Revitalization Formation could almost be described as immediate.

Even Mo Hua was a bit surprised.

Everyone was elated.

Dan Zhu, feeling a great relief, looked at Mo Hua with deep respect.

Righteousness filled his body, dispelling great evil, with a compassionate heart, healing and saving lives.

Though only at the Foundation Establishment Realm, he had the Divine Power to communicate with the heavens, worthy of being "Mr. Witch."

Ba Shan, Ba Chuan, the two Golden Core Elders, and the other barbarian soldiers from the Danque Tribe, witnessing this nearly "resurrection" miracle, felt immense gratitude and admiration for Mo Hua, this "Shaman Lord."

Chi Feng, watching the scene before him, found it almost unbelievable.

In less than two hours, without any rituals or ceremonies, this "Mr. Witch" genuinely communicated with the Divine Lord?

And was even directly given Divine teaching and painted the saving Holy Patterns?

What kind of profound Divine Power?

What deep Divine favor?

Would such a high Divine truly favor "humans" to this extent?

Was this "Shaman Lord" truly born into the world to carry out the deity’s will?

Chi Feng’s mind was shaken, struggling to calm down.

Mo Hua, however, watched the Wood Revitalization Formation intently, puzzled and lost in thought.

The Wood Revitalization Formation continuously generated Yimu energy, replenishing the Danque Tribe’s wounded soldiers’ diminishing Blood Qi.

These Danque soldiers, their faces pale, with their foreheads gradually turning black, slowly began to recover from their injuries.

The "Death Qi" enveloping them started to dissipate, replaced by strands of pale white...

"Vitality."

As Mo Hua watched, his heart suddenly jolted, his expression changing drastically.

Death Qi and... Vitality?

Death... and life?!
